title: Post-call: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path (Sunrise Health)
text:
Post-call: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path (Sunrise Health)

["From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nolan <alex.nolan@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path

Alex — thanks for the 30-minute call today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps we discussed.

Key takeaways from today's discovery:
- Primary workload: clinical note summarization + triage prompts for 1M patient messages/month (peak/avg skewed toward daytime).
- Expected inference shape: short prompts (avg 150 tokens) with occasional 1–2k token contexts for multi-turn summaries.
- Target integration timeline: pilot in Q2, expansion in Q3 if pilot metrics hit latency and cost targets.

Preliminary monthly token-volume bands (for pricing cadence):
- Band A (pilot): 25–75M tokens / month (~$10k–$40k monthly spend)
- Band B (growth): 75–250M tokens / month (~$30k–$125k monthly spend)
- Band C (scale): 250M+ tokens / month (>$125k monthly)

Unit economics (ballpark, list pricing):
- List: $500 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Committed tiers: 5–10% at 100M/mo, 15–25% at 250–500M/mo depending on term and model family
- Target we discussed on call: aim for ~$400 / 1M at initial committed band; we can show concrete scenarios below.

Procurement path / thresholds you flagged:
- Credit-card/self-serve OK for pilot up to ~$15k/month
- PO + standard SOW for >$25k/month (needs procurement & legal review)
- Enterprise contract (and finance approval) for >$100k/month

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach a simple Excel with three modeled monthly scenarios (attached) and a one-page pricing breakdown.
2) Please confirm which band Sunrise expects to target for the pilot and whether procurement will issue a PO at ~$25k–30k/month.
3) If procurement wants a sample SOW and billing contact, loop them in and I’ll send the template and our billing details.

Attachments: usage_estimate_sunrise_v1.xlsx, redwood-pricing-1M-breakdown.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump back on a 15-min call to walk through the numbers live.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

", 'From: Alex Nolan <alex.nolan@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Meera Patel <meera.p@sunrisehealth.com>, procurement@sunrisehealth.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path

Marissa — thanks for the quick write-up and the attachments. A few clarifying points from our side: 
1) Our best estimate for pilot is ~60M tokens/month (Band A). If pilot metrics look good we expect to move to ~120–150M/month in the quarter after.
2) Can you confirm whether the $/1M you quoted is net (after volume discounts) or list? We need to show finance an expected net rate.
3) Procurement wants to know if Redwood can accept POs at the $25k/month level and what billing cadence (monthly invoice, Net30) you support.
4) Security questions: do you have SOC 2 Type II? Any EU data residency options? (Alex is in the US but we have users in EU).

Meera (procurement) — looping you in here to confirm purchase thresholds and PO process.

Alex Nolan
Director, Digital Clinical Ops
Sunrise Health
alex.nolan@sunrisehealth.com
', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nolan <alex.nolan@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Meera Patel <meera.p@sunrisehealth.com>, procurement@sunrisehealth.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path

Alex / Meera — answering inline: 

1) Net vs list: the numbers I sent earlier were list price comparables. For a committed pilot band (60M/mo) we typically propose a 6–12 week pilot commitment and translate that into a committed monthly minimum for discounting. Example scenarios (attached commit-pricing-scenarios.csv):
- No commit (on-demand): $500 / 1M
- Pilot commit (60M/mo, 3 months): $460 / 1M effective (~8% off list)
- 12-month commit (100M/mo): $405 / 1M effective (~19% off list)
- 12-month commit (300M/mo): $340 / 1M effective (~32% off list)

2) PO & billing cadence: we can accept PO-backed invoices starting at $25k/month. Billing options: monthly invoice, Net30 terms; we can also provide quarterly billing for larger committed deals. For pilot-sized PO (~25–30k/month) standard PO + SOW is the path.

3) Procurement thresholds: as discussed on call, internal approvals at Sunrise usually look like:
- <= $15k/month — procurement approval, credit card possible
- $15k–$50k/month — PO + standard SOW (procurement + ops sign-off)
- > $50k/month — requires legal review and finance signoff (may add 2–3 weeks)

4) Security / compliance: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant; we also support EU region hosting for customer data on request. I’ve attached our compliance one-pager and can provide the full SOC2 report under NDA.

Next concrete items from Redwood if you confirm pilot band:
- Draft SOW + pilot schedule (using redwood-sow-template.pdf)
- Invoice/billing contact and PO instructions
- Mutual Action Plan (HubSpot link) to track milestones

I’ve attached commit-pricing-scenarios.csv with a few modeled spend rows and a one-pager PDF that breaks down the $/1M math (redwood-pricing-1M-breakdown.pdf).

Would you like to lock a 15-minute sync Friday 10am PT to review the scenarios?

—
Marissa
', 'From: Meera Patel <meera.p@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Nolan <alex.nolan@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@sunrisehealth.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path

Marissa — thanks for the details. Procurement confirms that Sunrise can issue a PO at the pilot level (we can do $25k–30k/month). Please send a sample SOW and the billing contact for our AP team (ACH details preferred).

Also include a primary Redwood contact for escalation and a short list of deliverables for the pilot (uptime SLO, latency targets, billing trigger). If pilot goes well we will prepare an RFP for the enterprise-wide rollout later this year.

Regards,
Meera Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
Sunrise Health
meera.p@sunrisehealth.com

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: monthly usage estimate, $/1M guidance & procurement path

Looping in internal finance cadence — I can approve a standard pilot discount up to 10% without Escalation. Anything beyond ~15% needs a pricing exception and VP approval (will take 48–72 hours).

Marissa — once Meera confirms the PO amount and billing details, I’ll re-run the deal economics with finance and confirm the final Net30 invoice template.

I’ll also add the proposed SLO bullets to the SOW before sending to Meera (uptime 99.5% for API, p95 latency < 700ms for typical prompt shapes).

-Ben
Director, Sales Ops
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
